blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA)
blocks.tamil_translation: rulings of the Deen will be asked, and in ignorance they will give judgements contrary to the law. As a result, those leaders will go astray themselves and lead others astray as well,” I heard the Prophet ﷺ say,” narrates Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ اللهَ يُبْغِضُ كُلَّ جَعْظَرِيٍّ جَوَّاظٍ سَخَّابٍ بِالْأَسْوَاقِ جِيفَةٍ بِاللَّيْلِ حِمَارٍ بِالنَّهَارِ عَالِمٍ بِأَمْرِ الدُّنْيَا جَاهِلٍ بِأَمْر اْلآخِرَةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن حبان (واسناده صحيح علي شرط مسلم):٢٧٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Allah detests everyone who is harsh by nature, who eats much, who shouts in the market places, who (sleeps) like a corpse by night, who roams about like a donkey by day, who knows the affairs of the world well and is without knowledge and understanding in the affairs of the Hereafter.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ الْجُعْفِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ قُلْتُ : يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! إِنِّي قَدْ سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ حَدِيثاً كَثِيرًا أَخَافُ أَنْ يُنْسِيَ أَوَّلَهُ آخِرُهُ فَحَدِّثْنِي بِكَلِمَةٍ تَكُونُ جِمَاعاً قَالَ: اِتَّقِ اللهَ فِيمَا تَعْلَمُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث ليس اسناده بمتصل وهو عندي مرسل باب ما جاء في فضل الفقه علي العبادة رقم:٢٦٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Yazid ibn Salamah Ju'fi (RA) says, “O Rasulullah, I have heard so many Ahadith from you. I fear that while I remember what I heard last, I may forget what I heard first. Therefore, teach me something comprehensive.” When he asked this, the Prophet ﷺ said, “Fear Allah in what you know” (that is, act according to what you have learnt).
